The Man — women's-division ace of the late 2010s.

How Becky Lynch connects

  • Item: WWE Women's Championship — Becky Lynch's The Man run was built on the WWE Women's Championship.
  • Event: WrestleMania — Becky Lynch main-evented WrestleMania 35.

What is Becky Lynch?

Becky Lynch's The Man run, WrestleMania 35 main event, and later returns made her the face of WWE's modern women's boom on Raw and SmackDown.

Key threads lead to WWE Women's Championship and WrestleMania.
